+        # input text preprocessing
+        text_bytes = text.encode("utf-8") # raw bytes
+        # the token sequence is kept as a str with one char per token id
+        # (chr(id)): str.replace merges a pair left to right without overlaps,
+        # exactly like merge(), but in C; pairs are tuples of 1-char strs
+        ids = text_bytes.decode("latin-1")
+
+        # iteratively merge the most common pairs to create new tokens
+        merges = {} # (int, int) -> int
+        vocab = {idx: bytes([idx]) for idx in range(256)} # int -> bytes
+        # count up the number of times every consecutive pair appears (once);
+        # afterwards the counts are updated locally around each merged occurrence
+        stats = get_stats(ids)
+        stats_values = stats.values()
